补充：设计取舍、重点代码与阅读路径

设计目的：前端按 route、core 数据层、业务组件、UI primitive 分层，是为了降低组件耦合。

维度

说明

收益

收益是展示层和数据请求分离，组件更容易复用。

代价

代价是一次用户交互常跨页面、hook、缓存、上下文和组件。

重点代码

重点代码在 frontend/src/app、frontend/src/core、frontend/src/components 对应模块。

阅读路径

阅读路径：先找 route，再找 hook 数据源，最后看组件消费。

stateDiagram-v2 [*] --> CheckMode CheckMode --> StaticUser: isStaticWebsiteOnly CheckMode --> DisabledUser: isAuthDisabledMode CheckMode --> ReadCookie: otherwise ReadCookie --> ConfigError: getGatewayConfig throws ReadCookie --> NoCookie: no access_token ReadCookie --> FetchMe: cookie present NoCookie --> SystemSetupRequired: setup-status needs_setup NoCookie --> Unauthenticated: setup-status ok or unreachable FetchMe --> Authenticated: /api/v1/auth/me 200 and userSchema ok FetchMe --> NeedsSetup: parsed needs_setup true FetchMe --> Unauthenticated: 401 or 403 FetchMe --> GatewayUnavailable: malformed or non-200 or timeout Authenticated --> AuthProvider: initialUser NeedsSetup --> SetupRedirect: layout redirect /setup SystemSetupRequired --> SetupRedirect: layout redirect /setup Unauthenticated --> LoginRedirect: layout redirect /login GatewayUnavailable --> OfflineFallback: GatewayOfflineFallback ConfigError --> [*]: layout throws StaticUser --> AuthProvider DisabledUser --> AuthProvider
